svg.title: The two waits in isolation
svg.desc: Four probe runs on the RTX 5060 Ti for each of stock vLLM, the KV preemption and the change at its 16-token window: in panel a, the KV case, the voice turn's first token while two agent requests of 18k tokens hold the pool (stock vLLM 4,900–4,971 ms; the KV preemption 219–290 ms; the change 216–294 ms); in panel b, the prefill case, its first token to its 16th while three agent prefills of 10k tokens run, the 16th at stock vLLM 1,220–1,529 ms; the KV preemption 1,211–1,528 ms; the change 536–615 ms.
